page_title: BUR 0-5 ARS | Burnley v Arsenal 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+9' What a chance that is! Josh Brownhill (Burnley) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
90+8' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for James Trafford to dive and make a save.
90+7' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
90+7' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Josh Brownhill (Burnley) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90+5' A clever short pass gives Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
90+3' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
89' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
88' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in David Datro Fofana (Burnley). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
86' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
85' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) sends a chip pass into the box, but James Trafford is quickest to intercept the ball.
84' Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kai Havertz.
83' The corner from Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.
80' That will be all from Wilson Odobert who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
80' Here is a change. Lorenz Assignon is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Vitinho (Burnley).
79' Substitution. Jorginho (Arsenal) on for Declan Rice.
78' 0 - 5 Goal! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) fires a rocket of a shot from just outside the box that goes into the middle of the net.
77' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
74' A bullet header by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the right post.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) will replace Leandro Trossard.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cedric (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as Ben White cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Bukayo Saka and he is replaced by Reiss Nelson (Arsenal).
68' Flag goes up against David Datro Fofana (Burnley) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

66' 0 - 4 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
66' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
65' Flag up against David Datro Fofana (Burnley). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
63' Aaron Ramsey is being substituted because of an injury. Vincent Kompany sends Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) on the pitch.
62' We are about to witness a subsitution. Charlie Taylor (Burnley) for Maxime Esteve.
59' Looks like Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
54' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
53' Jarred Gillett couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) and blew his whistle.
51' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) is caught offside!
50' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
49' The corner from Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) is hurriedly cleared.
47' 0 - 3 Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort into the top right corner.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zeki Amdouni departs the field of play to be replaced by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jarred Gillett didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
41' 0 - 2 Goal! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of James Trafford.
41' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
39' The foul by Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jarred Gillett.

39' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee blows his whistle and awards Arsenal a penalty after chaos inside the box.
38' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) swings it in and Kai Havertz gets on the end of it, but James Trafford shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
35' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
33' Ben White (Arsenal) is penalised for a foul. Jarred Gillett had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
30' One of the Burnley players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
29' That was close. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
27' A snap shot by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but David Raya produces a good save to thwart him.
24' A dangerous looking corner kick from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared to safety by the defence.
22' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
21' Declan Rice (Arsenal) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
14' The game is pretty dull as Burnley are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
10' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
7' Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jarred Gillett ignores the protests.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
3' The Arsenal players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will officiate today.
